free_tier.stated: No total storage cap stated. Per-account upload policy: 4 GB per file, 2 hours per file, 15 videos per 24 hours, 10 hours of content per 24 hours (standard creators). Premium/Edge lifts to 64 GB/file and unlimited duration.

egress.terms: Free, ad-supported CDN playback. No egress meter on standard accounts.

tooling: yt-dlp `dailymotion` extractor (verified present) plus `dailymotion:playlist|search|user`. Official Data API with resumable upload.
chaining: 10 hours of content per 24 h per account x unlimited accounts. At a 4 GB/2 h ceiling that is ~20 GB/day ceiling per account, ~7 TB/year, if you fill every slot.
limits_note: 4 GB per file is small for bulk. 15 videos/24h and 10 h/24h are enforced by suspension of upload privileges for 24 hours, which makes it a bad target for automated batch loading.
reliability_note: Exceeding either the count or duration limit suspends uploads for 24 hours; the platform is also ad-driven and aggressively deletes non-video content, so it is not a general blob store.
confidence_note: One page read moves it to documented.
